name: Core typed operational command
purpose: Request an authorized Core manufacturing transition with exact identity, world, target and revision/freshness binding.
authority_level: Core accepts intent and owns canonical state mutation; Automation owns workflow orchestration and effect verification.
security_classification: Protected manufacturing command metadata; no credentials or Oracle labels

semantics.identity: command_id and idempotency_key are immutable; command_type and command_version are stable
semantics.preconditions: Entity revisions are opaque strings; stale or unavailable revision/freshness rejects fail closed
semantics.outcomes: ACCEPTED is durable acceptance only and is never VERIFIED_SUCCESS; REJECTED and UNRESOLVED are durable
semantics.idempotency: Same key and same immutable command returns the original outcome; same key with another fingerprint is CONFLICT
semantics.world: world_id, correlation_id and causation_id are explicit and never inferred
